Package it.unipd.inferer.api

Class InfererControllerTest

java.lang.Object
it.unipd.inferer.api.InfererControllerTest
@WebMvcTest(InfererController.class) public class InfererControllerTest extends Object
Class InfererControllerTest

Summary: This test suite is responsible for verifying the functionality of the InfererController. It ensures that the controller's endpoints are correctly exposed and handle HTTP requests as expected. The tests cover the health-check endpoint, single document inference, and batch document inference. The service layer (DocService) is mocked to isolate the controller and focus on its request handling and response generation logic.

Test Suite Design: The test suite uses Spring Boot's WebMvcTest to test the web layer without a full application context. MockMvc is used to perform HTTP requests against the controller, and MockitoBean is used to provide a mock implementation of the DocService. This setup allows for focused, fast, and reliable tests of the controller's behavior.

  • Method Details

    • testHello

      @Test public void testHello() throws Exception

      Summary: Tests the health-check endpoint.

      Test Case Design: A GET request is sent to "/api/v1/hello".

      Test Description: This test verifies that the "/api/v1/hello" endpoint is active and returns the expected welcome message.

      Pre-Condition: The application is running, and the controller is up.

      Post-Condition: The endpoint returns a 200 OK status and the correct string.

      Expected Results: The response body should be "Hello this is a test, service INFERER UP!".

      Throws:
      Exception - if any error occurs during MockMvc execution

    • testInferTopics

      @Test public void testInferTopics() throws Exception

      Summary: Tests the single document inference endpoint.

      Test Case Design: A POST request with a sample Document object is sent to "/api/v1/infer". The DocService is mocked to return a processed document.

      Test Description: This test ensures that the "/api/v1/infer" endpoint correctly receives a document, passes it to the service, and returns the processed document.

      Pre-Condition: The DocService is mocked to return a specific Document when its infer method is called.

      Post-Condition: The endpoint returns a 200 OK status and the JSON representation of the processed document.

      Expected Results: The response body should be the JSON of the document returned by the mocked service.

      Throws:
      Exception - if any error occurs during MockMvc execution or JSON processing.

    • testInferBatchTopics

      @Test public void testInferBatchTopics() throws Exception

      Summary: Tests the batch document inference endpoint.

      Test Case Design: A POST request with a list of Document objects is sent to "/api/v1/inferBatch". The DocService is mocked to return a list of processed documents.

      Test Description: This test verifies that the "/api/v1/inferBatch" endpoint can handle a list of documents, delegate processing to the service, and return the list of results.

      Pre-Condition: The DocService is mocked to return a specific list of Documents when its inferBatch method is called.

      Post-Condition: The endpoint returns a 200 OK status and the JSON representation of the list of processed documents.

      Expected Results: The response body should be the JSON of the list of documents returned by the mocked service.

      Throws:
      Exception - if any error occurs during MockMvc execution or JSON processing.
